sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The new review process needs a calibration step.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Last year, ratings varied a lot between departments for similar performance.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Calibration meetings take a lot of manager time.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We do calibration, but only once a year, not twice.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's workable.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Ratings for similar performance differed a lot across departments last year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And calibration costs managers a lot of time.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Annual calibration only, then.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to introduce a four-day summer schedule.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: In the pilot team, output stayed the same and sick days went down.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What about customer-facing teams?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: They'd rotate the fifth day.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Roll it out company-wide for July and August.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: People will be thrilled.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Did the four-day summer pilot work?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Output was unchanged, and sick days dropped.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Customer-facing teams would rotate the day off.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Then let's do it for everyone in July and August.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Next, salary bands.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We're about {PERCENT} below market for senior engineers.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: {PERCENT}, that's interesting.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Adjust the senior engineering bands in this year's review cycle.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Long overdue.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Senior engineer salaries are around {PERCENT} under market.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay, {PERCENT}, noted.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: We've lost two people over it.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We correct the senior engineering bands in this review cycle.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great.
